paragraphs: Rabbi Levi bar Zekharyah: Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:14. R’ Nachmani bar Zekharyah: Shabbat 127a.
Rabbi Shimon bar Zekharyah: Jerusalem Talmud Demai, chapter 2, halakhah 1.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Shabbat 127a names Rav Nechumi bar Zekharyah asking Abaye. Hyman supplies Nachmani and abbreviates the title ר׳; the translation preserves his name form and records the full Rav witness title. The other two notices remain separate.

Midrash Rabbah–TE Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:14 names Rabbi Levi bar Zekharyah. William Davidson Shabbat 127a has Rav Nechumi bar Zekharyah, beside Hyman’s Nachmani; R’ preserves Hyman’s abbreviated title without resolving that name difference. Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Demai 2:1 has Rabbi Shimon ben Zekharyah, beside Hyman’s bar form.
